paper_title: A Generative-AI-Driven Claim Retrieval System Capable of Detecting and   Retrieving Claims from Social Media Platforms in Multiple Languages
caption: Number of participants (N=6) who highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants who identified various evaluation criteria as beneficial. The vertical axis lists the criteria, while the horizontal axis displays the number of participants, with values ranging from 0 to 6, marked at intervals of 2. The chart features bars of different colors, each representing a criterion: Relevant FCs, colored purple, has a value of 6; FC Summary, colored blue, has a value of 5; Relevance Explanation and Clarity and Simplicity, colored teal, both have values of 3; Overall Summary, colored green, has a value of 2; and Filters and Veracity Explanation, colored lime green and yellow-green respectively, both have values of 1. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and the criteria are listed in a descending order of the number of participants who identified them as beneficial, with no bars visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
